items.required_invariant_evidence: technical-specification.md lines 359-362 and 490-500 require project sync to derive only from project manifests and not read foreign template content; FeatureWorkflow.psm1 lines 241-278 and 936-943 globally load/validate both namespaces before filtering.
items.title: Project-only sync validates foreign template manifests before namespace selection
items.evidence: In an initialized derived repository, an invalid inherited template manifest prevents -Scope Project from updating a valid owned project dashboard and the wrapper can misattribute the global manifest failure to namespace=project.

items.title: Dual-host SHA proof compares hashes only within each host process
items.evidence: AUTO-TF0008-SPEC-TEST-001: feature-workflow.tests.ps1 lines 430-449 create a process-local hash set and Complete-Tf0008Identity emits no hash. PowerShell 5.1 can produce H1 and PowerShell 7 H2 while both independent suites pass, so PRD-AC-001 cross-host byte equality is not proven.

items.title: SPEC-TEST-015 omits required validators in the isolated ru-RU fixture
items.evidence: AUTO-TF0008-SPEC-TEST-015: feature-workflow.tests.ps1 lines 452-461 perform only sync/check and date assertions before passing identity 015; the isolated fixture does not run feature-workflow or repository-layout validation, so either validator can fail while the identity remains green.

items.title: SPEC-TEST-017 awards release-gate credit without executing repository gates
items.evidence: AUTO-TF0008-SPEC-TEST-017: feature-workflow.tests.ps1 lines 905-936 checks command exports, attributes, BOMs, and Windows build only, then passes identity 017 without running feature validator, all-scope dashboard Check, layout validator, git diff --check, or Rojo build.

items.required_invariant_evidence: The feature-workflow rule requires every derived all-namespace Check manifest failure to identify the failing namespace/ownership and provide owning or upstream recovery (.agents/rules/feature-workflow.md lines 80-84; technical-specification.md SPEC-TEST-008/014 diagnostics around lines 421-433). Both independent full Reviews show scripts/FeatureWorkflow.psm1 lines 113-119, 255-270, and 945-974 can let strict decode/JSON/surrogate errors escape before ownership-aware wrapping or prefix an owned project failure with the caller dashboard namespace.
items.title: All-namespace manifest failures can lose or misattribute ownership-aware recovery
items.evidence: Independent reports tests/deterministic-feature-dashboard-validation/review/final-review-security-01-report.md (SHA 7b67593f3be363d53438f4840a8910d1ef66c9ff8aa64ab61b3a42762b926b62) and tests/deterministic-feature-dashboard-validation/review/final-review-integration-01-report.md (SHA dd784932c251b974f3974b978a94ac1e2101f7258b9a7f93285264fd7a65d600) reproduce the same root cause. All 18 automated identities and release gates pass because the suite restores the invalid foreign manifest before all-namespace Check and does not assert namespace/ownership recovery for early strict parse failures.
